title: Relatives and possible family photographs
summary: Arthur suggests cousins and half brothers' families in California might have pictures of his grandfather and father.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren

blocks.x: I have a cousin here that probably could give you all so much if you could find him. I have another cousin, the one in California talking about foot and he might have heard
of his father. Who was his father? Which one of the veins?
Well he was the father that I lived, he never played the instrument, he was the one who made mattress.

Now I don't know if any of them would have a picture of the grandfather, which would be my grandfather and my dad, I don't know if any of them would have a picture of them old timers. Maybe, maybe not.
Do you know of any of your half brothers, families, still around?

Most of those boys died and the older people too, I don't know any of them. I think they have one sister left, she's out in California, one of the boys too was out in California, he died about eight years ago, but he has a sister out there by the name of the other. She's out there. Now I think my brother John, to have brother John, I think that he, his wife is still there and his daughter, but I think they are out in California. Now they might have something, but they are out in California, I wouldn't know, I've heard from them people in, or better than eight or ten years.
Of course it's mainly the musicians that I was interested in present, but... You know, I thought you could get maybe their father's pictures. Yeah, yeah, they were in there pictures.

You see, Bob, that being her husband's daddy too, she might have had, he might have had a picture something of the grandfather, you see, then I don't know, I don't remember that. So those people have been away there, everyone's been away so long.
